summary: Tested UI/UX refonte for health/coaching app. All requested features verified: Minceur page has blue header + white card + Nora button at top + 3 separate charts + exercises section. Health page defaults to light mode. ProDayView shows uniform meal/exercise cards with images on left. Activity-detail page does NOT show 'Exercices prescrits' section. Goal form popup uses dark glass overlay.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI/UX refonte completed and verified. Minceur page shows blue header with white card layout, Nora analysis button at top, 3 separate charts (weight, fat, muscle), meals section, and exercises section with uniform card design. Health page defaults to light mode (isDark=false when localStorage chutex_dark is not set). ProDayView shows uniform cards with images on left side. Activity-detail page correctly shows 'Exercices du jour' without 'Exercices prescrits' section.

minceur_page_blue_header.details: Blue fabric background image header with 'Poids & Nutrition' title, balance image, current weight display

minceur_page_white_card.details: White rounded card below header with all content sections

minceur_page_nora_button_at_top.details: 'Voir l'analyse de Nora' button appears at top of white card, before charts

minceur_page_3_separate_charts.details: 3 separate chart cards: Evolution du poids (74.5kg), Masse grasse (23.4%), Masse musculaire (44.5%)

minceur_page_exercises_section.details: 'Vos exercices du jour' section with exercise cards showing images on left, gray background, black text

minceur_goal_form_dark_glass_popup.details: Goal form opens as dark glass overlay with backdrop-filter blur, swipe pickers for weight and duration

health_page_light_mode_default.details: Health page defaults to light mode when localStorage chutex_dark is not set (isDark=false)

prodayview_exercise_cards_uniform.details: Exercise cards in ProDayView show image on left side with gray background and black text

prodayview_meal_cards_uniform.details: Meal cards in ProDayView show food image on left side with gray background and black text

activity_detail_no_exercices_prescrits.details: Activity-detail page shows 'Exercices du jour' section but NOT 'Exercices prescrits' section
